requests.title: Make the times the main thing
Keep AM/PM on the same line
Show more with blessed times, for free
Notify me when it's prayer time
Use Subuh or Fajr depending on where I'm from
Show clearly when I'm facing the qibla
An icon that looks like a prayer app, not astrology
See everything on one screen without scrolling
Bring back the colourful timetable look
Prayer alerts during Focus / Do Not Disturb
Switch the Prayer screen style from the Prayer screen
Blessed times in English for all Muslims in Singapore
